event.description: Prune one lowest-salience feed-forward unit per block
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 2,656 parameters at 99.980000%, a +0.980000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 12 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted in-family result is attempt-0022, width 10 under independent QKV at 3,040 parameters and 99.85%; the most recent failed in-family result is attempt-0027, salience-pruned width 14 under shared QKV, which validly scored 0.00%. Hypothesis: attempt-0027 may have crossed a discrete sensitivity boundary by removing two units per block; retaining 15 of 16 using the same two-sided norm score removes only 64 parameters and yields 2,592. This parameterization-preserving exact-boundary test is more informative than fresh width-15 retraining because it directly determines whether any individual trained feed-forward channel is dispensable, and it is more informative than another width below 14 because the measured width-14 checkpoint failed catastrophically.
